title: Read Input Registers with seven-register payload expectation
purpose: Reach the Read Input Registers parser and response-storage path using the issue-associated quantity of seven registers, with a valid request that can exercise response decoding at a nontrivial size.

messages.label: Read Input Registers request, unit 02, address 0, quantity 7

expected_behavior: A conforming server should parse the complete request and return seven input registers, or return a normal protocol exception when the selected unit or address is unavailable.
constraints_preserved: MBAP length 0006 matches the unit identifier and five-byte FC04 request PDU.
Quantity 0007 matches the issue-associated operation size and is positive.
Function code 04 matches Read Input Registers.
Hex is lowercase and contains no separators.
issue_safety_notes: The candidate targets parser and response-storage depth using a valid FC04 request inspired by issue-reported operation size. It does not copy a crash payload, omit required request fields, or assert that model-prior behavior is verified.
